title: Gated Beta Sprint Rollout and Lighthouse Success Metrics
creator: Asha Rao
description: Run a gated beta sprint design for lighthouse accounts to validate end-to-end onboarding, release notes clarity, and feedback-to-action latencies. The goal is to establish a repeatable, cross-functional cadence that yields measurable adoption and surface-level quality signals within 4 weeks of rollout. This ticket coordinates product, engineering, design, customer success, and growth for a controlled activation of 8 lighthouse customers across two waves.
acceptance_criteria: Eight lighthouse accounts enrolled and assigned to Wave A (4) or Wave B (4)
Release notes package (user-facing summary + changelog + migration steps) published to Docs and shared in GTM playbook channel
Onboarding checklist automation triggers (Welcome email -> Integration doc -> Success call) completed for each Wave A customer within 3 business days of enrollment
Feedback ingestion pipeline created: feedback form -> shared Slack queue -> triage board in Drive with standard tags and owner assignments
Telemetry dashboard shows: 1) activation rate within 7 days, 2) median time-to-first-successful-inference, and 3) regression alerts for quality drop — all populated with baseline data for Wave A
Rollout rollback criteria documented and validated with engineering (SLO breaches, critical data loss, severe functional regression)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pre-launch): finalize release notes draft, create onboarding playbook, stakeholders sign-off
Phase 1 (Wave A, 4 accounts): run 1-week intensive onboarding, collect qualitative feedback, instrument dashboards
Phase 2 (Internal rewind): product and eng review Wave A signals, implement quick fixes and hotfixes as needed
Phase 3 (Wave B, 4 accounts): expand rollout with updated release notes and automation, validate scaling behavior
Phase 4 (Open beta): if success thresholds met, open backlog for next 20 customers and announce GA window
release_notes_coordination: Template: one-paragraph summary, 3 bullets of customer-facing changes, breaking changes section, & troubleshooting known issues
Owner: Product Lead (Asha Rao) to maintain canonical copy in Docs; Eng to provide migration/compatibility notes by EOD 2026-03-05
GTM packaging: CS to produce a 30-second customer-facing digest and 1-page internal FAQ; Growth to prepare email drip for lighthouse cohort
Change tokens: attach metadata tags to each note (severity, migration-risk, action-required) to drive prioritization in support triage
Sign-off: final release notes published only after Security and SRE review pass (links to approval PRs included below)
stakeholders: Engineering: Ben Martinez (assignee), Claire Zhang (runtime lead)
